resources.string: Block distracting apps with schedules, focus sessions and daily limits.

Uninstall protection is active. Android will refuse to uninstall Blockthis until the device admin is deactivated in system settings — and while a strict block is running, those settings are blocked too.
Blockthis uses device admin only to prevent the app from being uninstalled while a block is active. It uses no other admin capabilities and cannot see your screen, password or data.
Could not open system settings on this device.
While a strict block runs, the entire system Settings app is blocked, not just the screens that could disable Blockthis.
No block lists yet.\nTap “New block list” to create one.
Turn on the blocking service (accessibility) or nothing will actually be blocked.
Strict block running — this block list is locked until it ends.
Always — blocked whenever the list is switched on
Schedule — blocked during weekly time windows
Focus sessions — start a timed block manually
Daily limit — blocked after a daily time allowance
While this list is blocking, it locks itself: it cannot be edited, switched off or deleted, and Blockthis cannot be disabled or uninstalled.
Strict mode is not available for Always lists, so a mistake can always be undone. For a permanent strict block, use a schedule that covers every day 24 hours.
Select at least one app to block.
Add at least one time window.
Enter a daily allowance of at least 1 minute.
Enter a session length of at least 1 minute.
Its apps will no longer be blocked.
If the end is at or before the start, the window runs into the next day. Equal start and end means 24 hours.
A strict block is running, so settings that could disable Blockthis are unavailable.
Deactivating this will let Blockthis be uninstalled. If a strict block is running, this screen should not even be reachable.

Blockthis uses this accessibility service to detect which app is in the foreground and to show a blocking screen over apps you chose to block, according to your schedules, focus sessions and daily limits. It also keeps its own settings screens unreachable while a strict block is running. Blockthis does not collect, store or share any personal data, screen content or typed text.
